calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the API history (Nov 13-17: 20,13,10,10,12), BTC price and macro backdrop. Kucoin's 21 for Nov 15 comes from a different publisher; the API shows 10, and the API governs. The remaining dispute was judgment: how much weight to put on persistence (Feb-Apr 2026) versus fast rebounds from extreme fear (Jul 2024, Aug 2026, Apr 2026). The dossiers' own 10-day-forward examples include rebounds to 26 and 46 from 12, so I keep the right tail out to the 90th percentile at 33. I carry forward the reference class all runs shared. No out-of-range escape is priced: the index has never printed below 5, and 81+ from 12 in 10 days is negligible. No retrieval on this run.
